name: payment_id
description: Surrogate payment attempt identifier, format PAY0000001.

name: provider_transaction_id
description: Payment provider's transaction reference. Business key: must be unique; duplicates indicate double-recorded payments.

name: payment_timestamp
description: When the attempt was processed (UTC); must be >= order_timestamp.

name: payment_status
description: captured = money taken; failed = attempt declined; pending = awaiting confirmation.

name: amount
description: Attempted amount in USD (> 0). For captured payments equals orders.order_total.

name: failure_reason
description: Set if and only if payment_status = 'failed'.
